end.summary:
Practised drawing dot pictures for square and triangular numbers.
Identified square numbers by matching rows and columns; distinguished a 12-dot rectangle from a square.
Used added row and column pictures to find increases from 6×6 to 7×7 and 9×9 to 10×10.
Found triangular totals through row sums and combined two triangles into a rectangle.
Explained the repeated-corner issue correctly in later examples, but teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised using dot pictures to explain square and triangular numbers. They correctly drew square and triangular patterns, found increases such as 13 and 19 by counting a new row and new column, and corrected the repeated-corner mix-up later in the lesson. At home, ask them to draw two nearby square numbers and mark the new row, new column, and shared corner.
